# garage Provider

Terraform provider for managing Garage S3 buckets via the Garage Admin API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    garage = {
      source = "jkossis/garage"
    }
  }
}

provider "garage" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:3903"
  token    = "your-garage-admin-token"
}


You will need to create an admin-token that is suitably scoped:

```
garage admin-token create \
  --scope CreateBucket,GetBucketInfo,UpdateBucket,DeleteBucket,AllowBucketKey,DenyBucketKey,CreateKey,ImportKey,GetKeyInfo,DeleteKey,ListBuckets,AddBucketAlias,RemoveBucketAlias \
  my-provider-token
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) The Garage Admin API endpoint URL. Can also be set via the GARAGE_ENDPOINT environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The Garage Admin API bearer token. Can also be set via the GARAGE_TOKEN environment variable.
